note: With allocation sampling distance set to 1, all 100 str_repeat allocations are selected for sampling. The probe yields between allocations so it does not overflow the bounded sample queue. Each call requests 136 bytes, which Zend MM rounds up to its 160 byte bin, so the probe stack must report 100 * 160 = 16000 bytes. Without rounding it would report 13600 bytes (-15%), outside the unchanged 4% margin.
